llama3.2.description: Balanced general-purpose chat model with strong instruction following for everyday assistant tasks.
llama3.2.resourceProfile: Low to moderate resource usage depending on quantization
llama3.2.extraTips: Use for fast local responses where broad capability matters more than depth.

mistral.description: Fast compact instruct model with strong short-form reasoning and low-latency responses.
mistral.extraTips: Great default for CPU-first local workflows.

qwen2.5.description: Capable multilingual and coding-friendly family suitable for mixed language tasks.
qwen2.5.resourceProfile: Moderate to high depending on size
qwen2.5.extraTips: Choose smaller variants for responsiveness, larger variants for quality.

deepseek-r1.description: Reasoning-focused model tuned for stepwise analysis and harder logical tasks.
deepseek-r1.extraTips: Use when quality of reasoning is more important than speed.

phi3.description: Small efficient model family optimized for lightweight local inference.
phi3.extraTips: Best option when memory or CPU budget is tight.

codellama.description: Code-oriented model family designed for generation, explanation, and refactoring support.
codellama.extraTips: Strong choice when your primary workflow is software development.

nomic-embed-text.description: Embedding model for semantic search and retrieval pipelines rather than chat generation.
nomic-embed-text.extraTips: Use this model for indexing and retrieval quality improvements.
